title: Live Operations Telemetry UX Foundation
goal: Deepen active-run visibility with task-level swimlanes and truthful telemetry cues grounded in existing run/task state.
scope: Build on the existing run-level SSE and polling fallback by rendering task pipeline swimlanes, live severity counters, and activity deltas from persisted run/task/finding state. Keep per-task stdout streaming and new worker protocols out of this first UX slice unless already available through existing task data.
generation_reason: Backlog refresh requested by the project owner after the previous queue ended at backlog item 10.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Stay inside real persisted run/task/finding state. Do not invent fake streaming telemetry or a second worker protocol.
notes: Use existing run and task snapshots first.
Any live animation must reflect actual state transitions.

success_criteria: Mission Control shows task-level progress grouped by tool or execution lane.
Live counters update from actual run/finding state instead of decorative fake events.
Queued, running, completed, failed, blocked, and thin-output states remain distinguishable.
Browser tests cover active, completed, failed, and SSE-unavailable behavior.
No new worker execution lane is introduced.
must_not_touch: pack registry and runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Telemetry UI is derived from persisted run/task/finding state.
No synthetic success or fake live state is added.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
The existing run-stream foundation remains intact.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with telemetry UX changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with live-operations UX baseline and remaining telemetry gaps.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
